concept: DR strategies: Warm Standby for an RTO of minutes
tests: Matching RTO minutes / RPO seconds and a budget to a DR strategy.
expected: Warm Standby — a scaled-down but fully functional copy in the DR Region, scaled up on failover. Triggers: "RTO of a few minutes", "RPO of seconds", "always-on standby, but not a full production copy".
why_not: Backup & Restore has an RTO of hours; Pilot Light keeps app servers off — slower to bring up; Single-AZ has no DR; Active/Active exceeds the budget.
